rules.check: Recheck at next decision cycle: if bank remains above 800 and production is still insufficient, continue adding production and reinforcing army.
rules.correction: Prioritize adding Gateway or Robotic Facility production to convert bank into army. Keep tech buildings (Twilight Council, Forge) queued if prerequisites are met. Avoid expanding until production is active and army supply is at least 15.
rules.title: Maintain Tech-Economy Tempo with Production Scaling
rules.when: Game time 4-6 minutes, bank above 800 minerals, production structures fewer than 3, and army supply below 20.

rules.check: Recheck at next decision cycle: if enemy composition remains bio-heavy, continue producing splash units and ensure detection is available.
rules.correction: Queue Colossus or High Templar (if Archives) to counter bio. Add Observer for vision if not already present. Maintain ground army strength and continue tech upgrades.
rules.title: Counter Terran Bio with Splash and Vision
rules.when: Enemy Intelligence shows Marines, Marauders, or Medivacs, and you have at least one Robotics Facility or Templar Archives.

rules.check: Recheck at next decision cycle: if army supply is still low and bank remains high, continue reinforcing and adding production.
rules.correction: Immediately queue units from all available production structures. If production is insufficient, add Gateways or Robotic Facilities. Prioritize army over expansion or tech. Do not expand until army supply is at least 15 and production is active.
rules.title: Recover from Low Army and High Bank
rules.when: Army supply below 15, bank above 1000 minerals, and production is idle or insufficient, or predicted advantage is OverwhelmingDisadvantage.
